title: mark_delivered does not update messages.delivery_state
description: OutboxStore::mark_delivered only deletes the outbox row and does NOT update messages.delivery_state to delivered. If a caller uses mark_delivered instead of complete_delivery for a successful message delivery, the message is stuck in pending forever with no outbox row and no retry. Both methods are pub with similar names; the critical distinction is documented only in a comment on complete_delivery, not in mark_delivered's own docstring.
